source: The Tracker tab (phase 12, pass 3; Vatsal, 17 Sep 2026): project management on the page. W01 to W09 moved here from data/dependencies.json (the team message of 16 Sep 2026, Spinach agenda item 7) with their saved rows; W10 onwards from the minutes of 16 Sep 2026 and Vatsal's decisions of 17 Sep 2026.
note: One row per item. Fields: id (W01..; the W series continues, never renumbered), item, direction (HoA to Spinach | Spinach to HoA | HoA internal), owner (comma-separated first names, or Spinach; empty when nobody is named yet), due_date (yyyy-mm-dd or empty), due_about (true when the date is approximate), status (not started | in progress | delivered | blocked | dropped: the row is folded into the row named by folded_into, keeps its ID and never renders; the page says so in one line), blocked_by (a row ID or empty), source (the cause), lands_at (where the deliverable will be), notes. Owner, due date, status, blocked by and notes are edited on docs/tracker.html; every edit is one row in board_entries (page tracker, item_id the W id); rows written before the move under page integrations are read too. milestones: the strip on top; the entry with final_by reads the date from the Integrations tab. board_link: the review link named in the daily update. The daily update and the question list are composed on the page from the board table; nothing here is hand-copied from it.
